name: Nesso_base
description: Firmware for the Arduino Nesso N1 (ESP32-C6) handheld controller. Features: clock/NTP, BLE scanner, WiFi scanner, LoRa (Meshtastic), IR remote (Flipper-compatible .ir files), RF433 sub-GHz, RFID2 card scanning, on-board BMI270 sensor screen, robot controller with up to 4 simultaneous inputs (seesaw gamepad, Mini JoyC HAT, Unit JoyStick2, Unit Joystick v1.1, and the built-in IMU as a tilt stick) over selectable WiFi-UDP/TCP, BLE or LoRa links (NessoLink RemoteFrame v1-v4 - the robot needs the NessoLink library 1.4.0 or newer), named controller profiles, Speaker Hat 2 audio, media screens, web file manager, and serial command interface.
keywords: ESP32-C6, Nesso, N1, handheld, IR, BLE, LoRa, WiFi, RF433, Arduino
author: ugursayar
